incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 5xx for /v1/chat/generate across us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 fallbacks. Error rate 17.9% over 5m, P95 latency up 2x. Paging oncall: mia

mia (oncall): on it. pulling logs now. seeing a bunch of "schema mismatch" errors from the chat runtime, looks like model returned an embeddings-only response in some cases.

sam (sre): that sounds like a model variant mismatch. any recent pins/rollouts?

mia (oncall): checking routing policy... `redwoodctl routing get --route /v1/chat/generate --env prod --region us-west-2`

deploy-bot: `2026-03-15T14:12:01Z redwoodctl: route /v1/chat/generate -> policy: smart-routing v3, pinned_variant: redwood-instruct-v2 (pinned=true), fallback: cross-region, fallback_variants: [redwood-chat-v1,q-lite]`

jackie (prod-eng): whoa pinned_variant is an *instruct* variant for the chat route. that explains the incompatible outputs. looks like a config push yesterday that mistakenly applied an instruct pin to the chat route (config id cfg-2026-0314-9).

karen-cs: impact? which customers hit this? I already have 2 customers on support pinging about garbled/empty chatbot replies.

mia (oncall): quick customer impact: using logs and tenant ids, 3 enterprise tenants saw >40% errors on chat path for ~20 minutes. internal telemetry shows 502s when the service tried to parse expected chat messages from the instruct model.

sam (sre): we need a mitigation plan: immediate options: 1) unpin the route to restore smart routing (preferred), 2) override to force compatible chat variant, 3) disable cross-region fallback to avoid loop, 4) rollback the config change.

mia (oncall): I'm going to unpin first to stop the incompatibility. running: `redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/chat/generate --pinned false --env prod --region us-west-2`

deploy-bot: `2026-03-15T14:16:22Z redwoodctl: updated routing for /v1/chat/generate: pinned=false (was redwood-instruct-v2). new effective policy: smart-routing v3, prefer redwood-chat-v1, cross-region fallback enabled`

mia (oncall): rolling restart of the chat-runtime in us-west-2 to pick up routing change and clear any stuck caches: `ops run restart chat-runtime --region us-west-2 --reason "pin mismatch mitigation"`

sam (sre): also recommend temporarily disabling cross-region fallback until we confirm no other pinned mismatches causing a cascading loop. doing: `redwoodctl routing update --route /v1/chat/generate --set fallback.cross_region=false`

deploy-bot: `2026-03-15T14:18:05Z redwoodctl: fallback.cross_region=false applied`

ryan (oncall-2): taking next shift in 10m, will monitor. do we have a revert for the bad config? cfg-2026-0314-9 needs to be reverted in the config repo and validated before reapplying.

jackie (prod-eng): I pulled the config PR. bad merge pattern: the instruct pin was present in a shared template used by both chat and instruct routes. fix is to split templates and add a validation check to CI that route type != pinned_variant.class. I'll open PR now.

mia (oncall): error rates are dropping already — 5xx down to 2.1% in us-west-2. P95 latency trending back to normal.

karen-cs: can we draft a short customer-facing note? say impacted from 14:02–14:20 PST for 3 tenants, degraded chat replies; root cause config pin mismatch, mitigation unpinned and disabled cross-region fallback. I'll prepare and send to CS after you confirm.

sam (sre): quick forensics: logs show the following repeated pattern when pinned to instruct variant:
```
ERROR runtime: schema mismatch parsing response -> expected: {messages: [{role, content}]}, got: {embeddings: [[...]]}
route: /v1/chat/generate, model_variant: redwood-instruct-v2, request_id: r-2f9c
```

mia (oncall): timeline summary: 14:02 alerting started -> 14:12 we confirmed pinned instruct on chat route -> 14:16 unpinned -> 14:18 disabled cross-region fallback -> 14:22 error rates back to baseline -> 14:35 restarted affected runtimes and validated recovery.

ryan (oncall-2): I'll keep monitoring for the next hour and then hand to the day SRE. setting an oncall note: `monitoring:chat-generate` and watch errors and fallback count.

jackie (prod-eng): PR opened: github.com/redwood/configs/pull/412 — adds template split + CI validation. Requesting review from infra & routing owners.

mia (oncall): small mitigation cleanup: re-enabled cross-region fallback at 14:55 after we validated configs and added a temporary assertion in the router: `if route.type == chat and pinned_variant.kind != chat -> deny-apply`

deploy-bot: `2026-03-15T14:55:12Z redwoodctl: fallback.cross_region=true applied`

sam (sre): post-incident actions (short): 1) add CI rule to block pins that don't match route type (jackie PR). 2) add canary gating for routing config changes that pin variants (deploy window + small traffic canary). 3) build a dashboard to surface pinned_variants mismatches across regions. 4) playbook update for incident response (unpin + disable-fallback).

karen-cs: customer note ready, will send now. thanks everyone.

mia (oncall): closing the page, will file a formal postmortem with timeline, root cause (config template bug + lack of validation), impact (3 tenants, ~18 minutes degraded, transient fallback load), and remediation steps. linking postmortem once created. :white_check_mark:

jackie (prod-eng): follow-up: adding an automated lint that runs `redwoodctl routing validate` on PRs.

ryan (oncall-2): ack. leaving monitoring in place for 60m.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: severity P2 -> impacted customers restored. Incident created: INC-2026-0315-18. Postmortem assigned to: jackie, due in 72h.
